title: Unit 13 Consolidation: Looking for Something You Have Not Found
goal: Review relative clauses with an unknown or non-existent antecedent, and read a short text about García Márquez and Cien años de soledad.

items: I can describe what I am looking for with que + subjunctive and tell it from a real thing.
I can say that nobody or nothing fits a description, and ask whether it exists.
I can put a preposition before the relative word and keep the subjunctive.
I can read a short text about García Márquez and Cien años de soledad.
